quarterly_data.signal: FormFactor's 10-Q says Systems market revenue for the three months ended June 27, 2026 rose 44.1% from $33,690 thousand a year earlier, primarily driven by sales of Triton, its recently introduced high-volume co-packaged optics (CPO) testing solution; six-month Systems revenue was $76,434 thousand, up 11.5% from $68,526 thousand, also primarily driven by Triton and partially offset by lower revenue from legacy product offerings as manufacturing capacity and customer demand increasingly shifted toward the Triton platform. Increased Triton demand also contributed to higher Taiwan revenue.
